root_cause.text: The function `hci_adv_bcast_annoucement()` in `net/bluetooth/hci_sync.c` lacks a size check before copying existing advertising data into a fixed-size temporary buffer, allowing a buffer overrun when the combined payload exceeds the buffer capacity.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds the check `if (adv->adv_data_len > sizeof(ad) - len)` before `memcpy(ad + len, adv->adv_data, adv->adv_data_len)` to reject oversized payloads and prevent overrunning the temporary buffer `ad`. The commit message explicitly states that prepending Broadcast Announcement service data to an already full advertising payload may exceed the temporary buffer size.

bic_trace_step.reason: The function `hci_adv_bcast_annoucement` now uses a buffer of size `HCI_MAX_EXT_AD_LENGTH` (instead of the previous 7‑byte fixed buffer) and appends existing advertising data via `memcpy(ad + len, adv->adv_data, adv->adv_data_len)`, then passes the combined length `len + adv->adv_data_len` to `hci_set_adv_instance_data`.
